nodes.description: msg.sender / _msgSender() - attacker controllable caller address used in ownership checks and transfer paths
block.timestamp (now) - miner/validator influenced time used for lock/unlock timing
_owner: privileged owner address controlling fee, exclusion and max tx settings
_previousOwner: owner stashed during lock(), restored by unlock()
_lockTime: timestamp until which owner functions are disabled
_isExcluded: mapping of accounts tracked in reflection-denominated balances
_isExcludedFromFee: mapping of accounts exempt from tax/burn fees
_rOwned: reflection-denominated balance mapping
_tOwned: token-denominated balance mapping used for excluded accounts
_rTotal: total reflection supply used to derive the rate
_tTotal: total token supply set at construction
_tFeeTotal: accumulated fees, readable through totalFees()
_taxFee: reflection tax percentage applied on transfers
_burnFee: burn percentage applied on transfers
_maxTxAmount: maximum transfer size enforced in _transfer()
_excluded: array of accounts excluded from reflection rewards, iterated in _getCurrentSupply()
_allowances: nested mapping of owner/spender approvals
unlock(): public function that restores _previousOwner as owner after _lockTime, guarded only by msg.sender equality
lock(uint256 time): onlyOwner function zeroing _owner and setting _lockTime = now + time
transferOwnership(address newOwner): onlyOwner ownership transfer
renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner function that sets _owner to address(0)
transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount): public ERC20 transfer delegating to _transfer
transferFrom(address,address,uint256): public transfer that also decrements the allowance
approve(address spender, uint256 amount): public approval writing _allowances
deliver(uint256 tAmount): burns reflection from caller and inflates _tFeeTotal
_transfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount): private core transfer with max tx and fee-exclusion checks
_tokenTransfer(...): private dispatcher choosing the excluded/non-excluded transfer variant
_transferStandard(...): private standard transfer path, both parties non-excluded
_takeBurn(uint256 tBurn): private helper crediting address(0) with the burn amount
_reflectFee(uint256 rFee, uint256 tFee): private helper reducing _rTotal and increasing _tFeeTotal
excludeFromFee(address account): onlyOwner function setting fee exemption
setMaxTxPercent(uint256 maxTxPercent): onlyOwner function recomputing _maxTxAmount
SpaceD constructor: initializes supply, rate, name/symbol, mints full supply to deployer and grants fee exemptions
includeInReward(address account): onlyOwner function removing an account from _excluded
excludeFromReward(address account): onlyOwner function adding an account to _excluded
owner(): public view returning _owner; called inside _transfer for the max tx exemption check
Timestamp-dependent access decision: require(now > _lockTime) in unlock()
Low-level value transferring call recipient.call{value: amount}("") with no reentrancy guard
Allowance subtraction _allowances[sender][_msgSender()].sub(amount) executed before/around transfer logic
Arithmetic recomputation _tTotal.mul(maxTxPercent).div(10**2) for _maxTxAmount
address newOwner parameter of transferOwnership()
uint256 time parameter of lock(), added to block.timestamp
uint256 tAmount parameter of deliver(), driving the reflection math
address recipient parameter of transfer()
uint256 amount parameter of transfer()
uint256 maxTxPercent parameter of setMaxTxPercent()
address account parameter of excludeFromFee()/includeInFee()/reward exclusion functions
uint256 taxFee parameter of setTaxFeePercent()
address msgSender local in the constructor holding _msgSender()
address sender local in deliver() holding _msgSender()
bool takeFee local in _transfer() deciding fee handling
uint256 currentRate local in _takeBurn()/tokenFromReflection() derived from _getRate()
setTaxFeePercent(uint256 taxFee): onlyOwner function writing _taxFee
Address.sendValue(address payable, uint256): library helper performing a raw value call

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against _previousOwner in unlock(), granting ownership restoration
block.timestamp (now) is compared with _lockTime to authorise unlock()
unlock() reads _previousOwner both for the guard and for the restoration
unlock() reads _lockTime in its timestamp requirement
unlock() writes _owner = _previousOwner, transferring all privileges
lock() stores the current owner into _previousOwner
lock() zeroes out _owner
lock() updates _lockTime with now + time
lock() derives _lockTime from the miner-controlled block.timestamp
transferOwnership() overwrites the privileged _owner state variable
onlyOwner modifier routes the caller (msg.sender) into the authorisation check of transferOwnership()
renounceOwnership() sets _owner to address(0), removing admin control
transfer() delegates all balance logic to private _transfer()
msg.sender is used as the from address of transfer()
transferFrom() delegates balance movement to private _transfer()
transferFrom() reads the nested _allowances mapping to size the spend
transferFrom() performs the allowance subtraction that can underflow if misused
msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom()
approve() writes the _allowances mapping via _approve()
deliver() uses _msgSender() as the sender whose reflections are burned
deliver() requires the caller not to be in _isExcluded
deliver() subtracts rAmount from the caller's _rOwned entry
deliver() reduces _rTotal by rAmount
deliver() increases _tFeeTotal by tAmount
_transfer() enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount for non-owner participants
_transfer() consults _isExcludedFromFee to decide whether fees apply
_transfer() hands off to _tokenTransfer()
_transfer() calls owner() to exempt owner-to-owner movements from the max tx limit
_tokenTransfer() branches on the _isExcluded status of sender and recipient
_tokenTransfer() calls _transferStandard() on the default branch
_transferStandard() performs checked subtractions and additions on _rOwned balances
_transferStandard() invokes _takeBurn() for the burn share
_transferStandard() invokes _reflectFee() for the reflection share
_takeBurn() credits the burn amount to _rOwned[address(0)]
_takeBurn() also credits _tOwned[address(0)] when the zero address is excluded
_reflectFee() subtracts rFee from _rTotal, shrinking the rate denominator
_reflectFee() accumulates tFee into _tFeeTotal
onlyOwner modifier validates _msgSender() against _owner before excludeFromFee() runs
excludeFromFee() flips an entry of _isExcludedFromFee, changing fee economics for an account
setMaxTxPercent() executes the multiplication/division that produces the new limit
setMaxTxPercent() writes an unvalidated value into _maxTxAmount
setMaxTxPercent() reads _tTotal as the scaling base
constructor assigns the deployer supplied _total into _tTotal
constructor computes _rTotal via MAX - (MAX % _tTotal); a zero _tTotal reverts the deployment
constructor initialises _maxTxAmount from _maxTxValue
constructor mints the entire _rTotal to the deployer in _rOwned
constructor marks owner() and the contract itself as excluded from fees
constructor mints to _msgSender(), the deployer address
includeInReward() toggles _isExcluded back to false for an account
includeInReward() mutates the _excluded array by swapping and popping an element
excludeFromReward() sets _isExcluded for an arbitrary owner-chosen account
excludeFromReward() pushes the account onto _excluded, lengthening the loop in _getCurrentSupply()
excludeFromReward() snapshots token balances into _tOwned
owner() reads the privileged _owner state variable
unlock() relies on the timestamp comparison represented by this unsafe operation
the timestamp check reads _lockTime as its threshold
the timestamp check reads block.timestamp, a miner-influenceable value
lock() produces the _lockTime value that the timestamp comparison later relies on
the allowance subtraction result is written back into the _allowances mapping
the mul/div arithmetic result becomes the new _maxTxAmount
newOwner parameter is stored into _owner by transferOwnership()
time parameter is added to block.timestamp inside lock()
tAmount parameter drives the reflection math in deliver()
recipient parameter of transfer() is forwarded to _transfer()
amount parameter of transfer() flows into the balance update
maxTxPercent parameter is scaled by _tTotal to set the transfer limit
account parameter is used to update the fee exemption mapping
taxFee parameter is written into the _taxFee state variable
msgSender local in the constructor carries _msgSender() into the mint and ownership setup
sender local in deliver() holds _msgSender() and indexes _rOwned
takeFee local controls whether fees are removed/restored in _transfer()
currentRate local is derived from _getRate() and scales the burn in _takeBurn()
Address.sendValue() executes the raw value call represented by this unsafe operation before any state reconciliation
setTaxFeePercent() writes an unrestricted value into _taxFee
